svg.title: One-shot weight synthesis and neural policy execution
svg.desc: A task specification is provided to a language model. Its saved assignments construct three weight matrices and biases for a 600 to 32 to 32 to 6 policy. The policy interacts with Breakout using sampled actions and encoded observations. Gameplay feedback does not return to the language model.
svg.text: No environment feedback to the LLM
20,486 parameters · MLP policy with tanh activations
